class.name: CbMotionSet
class.brief_description: A mod's motions: the [CbMotion] nodes under it, baked to one file the server reads.
class.description: The root of a scene in the mod's project ([code]motion_sets/[/code]). Its [CbMotion] children, in the order of the scene tree, are baked to [code]res://motions/<set_name>.cfg[/code] when the scene is saved, by the Bake button, and when the mod is published. The server mod names the set with [code]declare.Motions( "dash.moves" )[/code]; the server reads the file from the mod's item and sends it to every client, and every simulation runs it. A server runs at most 16 motions, all its mods' sets together. The scene itself is not shipped: the baked file is.

method.name: bake
method.description: The baked text: [code]{ text, error, motions }[/code] ([code]text[/code] is empty when a motion cannot be baked, and [code]error[/code] says which and why).

method.name: bake_to_project
method.description: What the Bake button and saving the scene do: writes [code]res://motions/<set_name>.cfg[/code], only when its bytes change.

members.member: The set's name, like the mod's other names: [code]dash.moves[/code]. The server mod asks for it by this name, and the baked file is named after it.
